# Swamp Grave

Type: Point of interest | Internal ID: Grave1 | Location: Swamp | Resources: Swamp chest | Inhabitants: Draugr, ,, Skeleton

# Introduction

Swamp Graves are Points of interest found in the Swamp. They are a circle of six large stones with two additional stones in the center.

## Resources

Swamp Graves are protected by two Body piles and one Evil bone pile.
There is a Swamp chest at the center of the formation.
The stones are indestructible and provide maximum support for building.
